class.name: NetwActionContext
class.brief_description: Information about a [NetwAction] request, passed to its method on the server.

method.name: bind
method.description: Links [param node] to this action, so the client's predicted copy is replaced by it. Call it before adding the node to the tree.

method.name: deny
method.description: Rejects the action. The requesting client undoes its prediction.

members.member: The server tick the action runs on.
The tick the client asked for.
The peer that sent the request.
The tick the client saw when it acted, no later than [member execution_tick]. Use it with [method Netw.rewind] and [method Netw.sample].
